script.title: PIZZA DELIVERY AND THE TIP
script.story_hook: A rainy night, hot pizza, and a confusing receipt.
script.intro_zh: 下雨的夜晚、熱騰騰的披薩，還有讓人困惑的收據。
script.welcome_en: Hey everyone! Today we're talking pizza delivery tips.
script.welcome_zh: 大家好！今天來聊聊披薩外送的費用和小費。
script.outro: Now tipping at the door is easy in English. Practice on!
script.outro_zh: 現在開門給小費對你來說超簡單，繼續練習囉！
script.practice_intro_en: Time to repeat. Copy me line by line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 該跟讀了，一句一句跟著我唸。
script.char_a_description: a sleepy-looking woman in her late twenties with a messy bun held up by a pencil, wearing an oversized college hoodie and fluffy slippers at her doorway
script.char_b_description: a warm-smiling man in his early forties with a close-cropped, gray-flecked beard, wearing a neon reflective delivery jacket and rain hood, holding an insulated pizza bag
script.youtube_title: 【🍕💸披薩外送英文】「到貨」才懂：運費、小費、QR-code 收款的 18 句對話｜🎧Delivery Tip English
script.youtube_title_en: "Tip Separate" — Questioning the Pizza Delivery Tip
script.youtube_description:
外送費裡到底有沒有包含小費？當面問會不會很尷尬？這集 18 句家門口對話一次拆開：運費歸店家、小費歸司機、沒現金怎麼辦、掃碼付款怎麼說。自然美式口語加上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就能從容收餐。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Does the delivery fee tip the driver? Ask at the door without the awkwardness. This 18-line porch scene untangles fees from tips, handles the no-cash moment, and covers paying by QR code, all in natural American English with IPA. A repeat-after-me section seals the phrases in.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🍕外送英文｜拆開運費・掃碼給費・雨天道謝｜聽完就會收餐｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
帳單上有運費，那司機的小費還算不算在裡面？
身上沒帶現金，門口該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進雨夜的家門口，跟著顧客與司機從對單、拆開運費與小費，到掃碼付款、雨天道謝，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🧾 對數額：例如「How much total?」、「Sixteen forty-five, tip separate.」
💸 拆費用：例如「three fifty goes to the shop, not me.」、「I thought the fee covered you.」
📲 掃碼與道謝：例如「See this QR sticker?」、「Driving in rain makes tips count double.」

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次外送小哥按門鈴，你也能笑著把費用問清楚！
script.thumbnail_expression: squinting at a receipt in confusion
script.thumbnail_action: holding a pizza bag and a small QR sticker

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, hi! That's the pizza from Mario's?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ haɪ ðæts ðə ˈpitsə frʌm məˈrioʊz/
dialogue.zh: 噢嗨！你是 Mario 家的披薩司機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's me. Large pepperoni, still hot.
dialogue.zh: 就是我。大份義式香腸披薩，還熱騰騰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amazing, you made great time. How much total?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈmeɪzɪŋ ju meɪd ɡreɪt taɪm haʊ mʌtʃ ˈtoʊtəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixteen forty-five, tip separate if you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksən ˈfɔrti faɪv tɪp ˈsɛpərət ɪf ju laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 十六塊四五，小費是另外計算的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, there's a delivery fee too? On top?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðɛrz ə dɪˈlɪvəri fim tu ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 等等，還外加運費嗎？在這之上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, three fifty goes to the shop, not me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛ θri ˈfɪfti ɡoz tə ðə ʃɑp nɑt mi/
dialogue.zh: 對，三塊五是店家收的，不是我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I'm sorry, I thought the fee covered you.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪm ˈsɑri aɪ θɔt ðə fim ˈkʌvərd ju/
dialogue.zh: 噢抱歉，我以為運費就含司機費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lots of folks think that, no worries at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑts əv foʊks θɪŋk ðæt noʊ ˈwɜriz ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 很多人都這麼想，完全不用在意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does the tip work? I don't have cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dʌz ðə tɪp wɜrk aɪ doʊnt hæv kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那小費怎麼給？我身上沒現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See this QR sticker? It goes straight to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðɪs kɑr ˈstɪkər ɪt ɡoz streɪt tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 看到這個收款貼碼了嗎？直接進我帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, scanning now... one sec, weak signal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ˈskænɪŋ naʊ wʌn sɛk wik ˈsɪɡnəl/
dialogue.zh: 好了，我在掃……等一下，訊號很弱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush, I'm parked right out front.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rʌʃ aɪm pɑrkt raɪt aʊt frʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 不急，我就停在門口前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, sent five dollars. Did that land?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt sɛnt faɪv ˈdɑlərz dɪd ðæt lænd/
dialogue.zh: 成功了，轉了五塊。你有收到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, pinged it, thank you so much, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp pɪŋd ɪt θæŋk ju su mʌtʃ ˈtruːli/
dialogue.zh: 有，跳提示了，真的非常感謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You deserve ten, honestly, it's pouring outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪˈzɜrv tɛn ˈɑnəstli ɪts ˈpɔrɪŋ aʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 說真的你值得十塊，外面雨超大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Driving in rain makes tips count double, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdraɪvɪŋ ɪn reɪn meɪks tɪps kaʊnt ˈdʌbəl trʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 雨天開車送費，小費都加倍珍貴，相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, take this bottle of water too, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr teɪk ðɪs ˈbɑtəl əv ˈwɔtər tu oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 來，這瓶水也給你了，好不？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're the best. Enjoy your pizza tonight!
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ðə bɛst ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jʊr ˈpitsə təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你太好了，今晚披薩慢慢享用！
